• Audit coach consistency across all active accounts—prioritise centres with high missed/rescheduled session rates and ensure coaches are reliable and deliver quality interactions.

• Implement a scheduling protocol that offers flexible time slots during initial onboarding to prevent early cancellations due to timetable conflicts.

• Review coach performance with Bianca and any others with high absence rates, and establish clear accountability standards for session delivery and preparation.
